response_text: agent-02 isn't eligible, and it comes down to almost no evidence yet rather than anything having gone wrong: only 2 decisions are on record, and just 1 of those was acted on (the other was escalated and later ruled on by a human). That single acted decision was correct, so the point accuracy reads 100% — but with n=1 the Wilson lower bound collapses to 0.207, nowhere near enough to support raising a limit (see ADR-0002: a small perfect record is weak evidence, not strong). Human agreement is the same story — 1/1 ruled escalation, Wilson lower bound 0.207. The reason codes spell it out directly: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE, AGREEMENT_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT, TRUST_BELOW_THRESHOLD, and WEIGHTS_RENORMALISED because the score had to be computed over whatever evidence does exist. There's no drift and no critical error working against it — it's on probation and simply needs many more decided invoices before the ladder has enough to evaluate.
